messages:
anika: Heads-up — my samplekit adapter just caused a schema validation failure in JSON mode when a tool/fncall retried due to auth. Repro below, pretty consistent.
anika: Repro steps: 1) call tool via SDK helper -> 2) transient 401 triggers retry logic -> 3) helper reassembles streamed chunks but wraps single object as an array -> schema validator expects object -> error.
anika: Log excerpt:
```
SDK Helper: got chunks: {"result": {"id": "abc"}}
SDK Helper: retry triggered, assembling buffered chunks -> [ {"result": {"id": "abc"}} ]
Validator: schema mismatch: expected object, got array
```
sanjay: Oof. Which SDK are you on? Node or Py?
anika: Node 1.9.0 (samplekit adapter). Customer repros were on Node and the onboard sampleapp failed to parse outputs.
maria: I think this is the old streaming-assembly behavior — Node helper would collect chunks and if it saw multiple frames it returns array, even when there's only one logical tool object after retry. Python helper normalizes to single object. That's why parity tests missed this.
tom: Can you paste minimal code that triggers it? Even a tiny snippet helps.
anika: Sure:
```
const resp = await client.callTool({name: 'lookup', input: q}, {jsonMode: true});
// underlying transport: got chunk A, 401 -> retry, got chunk A again -> helper returned [A]
await validateSchema(resp);
```
maria: Fix idea: in the helper normalizeAnyArrayOfSingleObject -> object if schema says object. Also add a strict-jsonmode flag that enforces shape at the boundary.
tom: I'll open a PR to normalize in the assembly layer and add a unit test that simulates a retry doubling the chunk list. Will add a changelog note about parity.
devex-bot: CI note: created test case ticket DX-1142 for flaky onboarding sampleapp.
anika: Thanks — this was blocking a handful of customer demos. Also note: onboarding guide currently suggests node sample as canonical, we should call out parity caveat until we patch.
sanjay: Can we add a fuzz test in CI that runs both SDKs against the same simulated chunked transport? Might catch other edgecases.
maria: Good idea. I'll sketch a test harness this afternoon and add to devex test matrix.
anika: I'll attach the repro package to the ticket (small node app + recorded chunks). Thanks all :thumbsup:\n
